races.name: Parti Québécois wins the most seats

markets.question: Will Parti Québécois win the most seats in the 2026 Quebec general election?
Yes if the PQ wins the most National Assembly seats in the 2026 Quebec election; a seat tie goes to the party entering government, then to vote share. (Kalshi KXQUEBECASSEMBLY-26OCT05-PQ)

Quebec General Election: PQ Wins a Majority?
Yes if the Parti Québécois wins at least 64 of the 125 National Assembly seats in 2026. (Kalshi KXQCPQSEATS-26OCT05-AL64)

races.name: Paul St-Pierre Plamondon is the next premier

markets.question: Will Paul St-Pierre Plamondon be the next Premier of Quebec following the 2026 Quebec general election?
Yes if Paul St-Pierre Plamondon is the first person to serve as Premier after government formation following the 2026 Quebec election, before 1 Jan 2027. (Kalshi KXQUEBECPREMIER-27JAN01-PSPP)

notes: Prices only: Élections Québec's live results file keeps only its latest state, and the Internet Archive holds three captures from election night (one before any box reported), so there is no count timeline and no model; accuracy and profit cannot be measured.

Prices: Polymarket 1-minute price history (YES token), 2026-10-05T22:00:00Z to 2026-10-06T16:00:00Z (18:00 to 12:00 EDT); a row is written only when the price changes (plus the last minute). Settled = price of the eventual outcome >= 0.9 from then to the end of the window.

Map: one final frame, the official final results file (isResultatsFinaux true). Colour = Parti Québécois share of PQ + Liberal votes. No prior: 2022 was held on 125 different circonscriptions and Élections Québec publishes no transposition onto the 2026 map. Units: 'winner' (party id, see parties) and 'margin' (winner minus runner-up, points of valid votes x10).
Result: Parti Québécois 60, Quebec Liberal Party 39, Conservative Party of Quebec 19, Québec solidaire 9 seats (127).

Already settled when the price window opened (18:00 EDT, before polls closed): most-pq, most-plq, most-caq, most-pcq, premier-psp.

Official timing, coarse: the first archived capture of Élections Québec's live file with at least 1% of polling stations reported is stamped 2026-10-06T01:31:08Z (12,296 of 20,704; PQ leading in 60 of 127, short of the 64 needed for a majority); Polymarket's 'PQ wins a majority' market settled 'no' at 2026-10-06T01:30:00Z.
